items.title: Efterglød
items.description:
Part of the group exhibition Efterglød - an annual exhibition by Sydhavn Theater and ST:ART, presenting video works in public spaces throughout the neighborhood of Sydhavn, Copenhagen. 
Mount Etna is based on text fragments and footage recorded during a trip to the volcano in Siciliy. As tourists walk down the slope, creating clouds of dust, a heat wave causes thousands of ladybugs to fly up the volcano, only to become trapped with nothing to eat. Meanwhile, a forest fire delays airplanes from taking off.

items.title: 19:00 ON TIME
items.medium: Chalk, extracts from personal diary, Iphone notes etc.
items.description:
Text work made as part of the performance event 19:00 ON TIME developed together with Line Rolf, Lukas Moland and Steinar Brovold Hauge at the top floor of the parking garage Bergen Bygarage.\
\
As the event was defined by the boundaries of a parking lot as a public gray zone, the text pieces, written in chalk, would remain only for as long as it took for rain and passing cars to wear them away.

items.title: *It’s lying there along with the tree, maybe we’ll see him later*
items.workTitle: *It’s lying there along with the tree, maybe we’ll see him later*
items.venue: Tag Team Studio and Galleri Flig
items.medium: Various concrete types, charcoal on paper, construction wood, construction foil, water and leaves from fountains in Bergen
items.description:
Duo project made together with Line Rolf, exhibited at Tag Team Studio and Galleri Flig.\
\
The project explores the elements that define the cityscape and how ordinary urban objects gradually become part of its visual and cultural landscape. Based on recordings of shadows found around in the city of Bergen, the works imagines new forms and narratives for city monuments. The works consists of an outdoor sculptural video screening alongside an installation of concrete casted reliefs of the silhouettes of parked and crashed electric scooters.
